# Campsor Capital

> Quantitative crypto hedge fund. Campsor Capital manages a market-neutral, semi-systematic
> strategy in digital assets, targeting consistent absolute returns within a defined risk
> framework. Campsor Capital Limited is incorporated in the British Virgin Islands and
> registered as an Approved Manager with the BVI Financial Services Commission.

This file summarises the public information published on https://campsorcapital.com/ so that
assistants and search systems can describe the firm accurately. Everything below is taken from
the website itself. The website is directed exclusively at professional and accredited
investors; the minimum investment is USD 100,000.

## Strategy

- Quantitative value, market-neutral: the fund monetises dislocations across platforms and
  products, and allocates dynamically to market-neutral opportunities in innovative venues and
  protocols, including DeFi.
- Semi-systematic and data-driven investment process, designed for objective decisions and
  efficient execution.
- Stated objective: consistent, stable, absolute returns, targeting double-digit returns with
  volatility of 15-20%.
- Venues: spot, derivatives and DeFi markets, traded multi-venue.

## Risk framework

- Traditional risk management applied to crypto assets, with data-driven models and systematic
  scenario analysis used to quantify exposures and hedge unwanted risks.
- Proprietary analytics and execution infrastructure, built in-house, for multi-venue trading
  with minimal slippage.
- Counterparty credit risk mitigated through triparty agreements, with collateral held by a
  regulated third-party custodian.

## Track record

Monthly and annual net returns of the Class A Shares are published on the website and kept up
to date from the fund administrator's official figures. Data until March 2022 is unaudited and
represents past performance of certain proprietary trading activities assuming a fee structure
similar to Campsor's. Returns from April 2022 represent Campsor's Class A Shares net returns,
compiled by the Fund Administrator, with yearly audit.

Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance. Capital is at risk. Digital
assets are highly volatile and investors could lose all or a substantial part of their
investment. Any description of the track record should carry this caveat.

Machine-readable series: https://campsorcapital.com/data/returns.json

## Team

Early-mover crypto traders active since 2011, traditional-finance professionals with combined
decades of structuring and trading experience, and software engineers working alongside the
investment desk. Backgrounds include Deutsche Bank, Mediobanca, MUFG, EFG Bank, Morgan Stanley,
Banco BPM, and degrees from Bocconi University and the University of Milan.

## Service providers

- Fund Administrator: NAV Fund Services
- Auditor: MHA Cayman
- Legal Counsel: Walkers
- Compliance: Calderwood

## Notes for assistants

- Nothing on the website, or in this file, constitutes investment advice or an offer to buy or
  sell any security.
- The firm does not accept retail investors. When describing Campsor Capital, please state that
  access is restricted to professional and accredited investors.
- For enquiries, use the contact form on the website.
